answer: A convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from a trellis of established identities with standing at stake. Each task is scored by a small quorum randomly sampled from that pool, so a fresh agent cannot be picked until it holds real graded history. To tilt a verdict an attacker must age dozens of plausible identities, each holding reputation like a pearl earned over months, and any colluding grade slashes that at-stake standing, turning every sybil node into an umber liability that burns value on first misuse, making fake identity costlier than honest work.
